definition: to write down what a customer wants to eat or drink
exampleSentence: The waiter took our order.
exampleTranslation: Người phục vụ ghi món của chúng tôi.

definition: to buy something using the internet
exampleSentence: I ordered a jacket online.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã đặt một chiếc áo khoác trên mạng.

definition: to arrange for a table to be kept for you in a restaurant
exampleSentence: I booked a table for eight o'clock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã đặt bàn lúc tám giờ.

definition: to request the list of food in a restaurant
exampleSentence: Could we ask for the menu, please?
exampleTranslation: Cho chúng tôi xin thực đơn nhé?

definition: to pay with a bank card
exampleSentence: Can I pay by card?
exampleTranslation: Tôi thanh toán bằng thẻ được không?

definition: to pay with notes and coins
exampleSentence: He paid in cash.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy trả bằng tiền mặt.

definition: to share the cost of a meal between people
exampleSentence: Let's split the bill.
exampleTranslation: Mình chia hóa đơn nhé.

definition: to give extra money to a waiter or driver
exampleSentence: Don't forget to leave a tip.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên để lại tiền boa.

definition: to eat at a restaurant instead of at home
translation: ăn ở ngoài, đi ăn nhà hàng
exampleSentence: We eat out once a week.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi ăn ngoài mỗi tuần một lần.

definition: to eat a small amount of food between meals
exampleSentence: I usually have a snack at four.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thường ăn nhẹ lúc bốn giờ.

definition: cheap food that is prepared and served quickly
exampleSentence: Fast food is cheap but not very healthy.
exampleTranslation: Đồ ăn nhanh rẻ nhưng không tốt cho sức khỏe lắm.

definition: food that is quick to prepare but not healthy
translation: đồ ăn vặt không tốt cho sức khỏe
exampleSentence: Try not to eat too much junk food.
exampleTranslation: Cố đừng ăn quá nhiều đồ ăn vặt không tốt cho sức khỏe.

definition: fruit that has just been picked or bought and is not tinned or dried
exampleSentence: I eat fresh fruit every day.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào tôi cũng ăn trái cây tươi.

definition: coffee with a lot of flavor
exampleSentence: I need a cup of strong coffee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần một tách cà phê đậm.

definition: coffee without milk
exampleSentence: He drinks black coffee with no sugar.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy uống cà phê đen không đường.

definition: a cold drink that does not contain alcohol
translation: nước ngọt, đồ uống không cồn
exampleSentence: Would you like a soft drink?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn uống nước ngọt không?

definition: drinking water sold in bottles
exampleSentence: I always carry bottled water when I travel.
exampleTranslation: Đi du lịch tôi luôn mang theo nước đóng chai.

definition: water that comes from the tap in your home
exampleSentence: Is the tap water safe to drink here?
exampleTranslation: Nước máy ở đây uống được không?

definition: a small meal that is not heavy
exampleSentence: I prefer a light meal in the evening.
exampleTranslation: Buổi tối tôi thích một bữa ăn nhẹ hơn.

definition: food with a strong, hot flavor
exampleSentence: She loves spicy food.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy rất thích đồ ăn cay.

definition: to like sweet food very much
exampleSentence: I have a sweet tooth, so I love cake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích đồ ngọt nên rất mê bánh.

definition: to visit shops to buy things
exampleSentence: Let's go shopping this weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần này mình đi mua sắm nhé.

definition: looking at things in shop windows without buying
translation: đi ngắm đồ ở cửa hàng mà không mua
exampleSentence: We spent the afternoon window shopping.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dành cả buổi chiều đi ngắm đồ ở các cửa hàng.

definition: to buy food and other things for the home
exampleSentence: I do the grocery shopping on Saturdays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi chợ vào thứ Bảy.

definition: a list of things you need to buy
exampleSentence: I wrote a shopping list before I went out.
exampleTranslation: Tôi viết danh sách mua sắm trước khi ra ngoài.

definition: a bag for carrying the things you buy
exampleSentence: She carried two heavy shopping bags.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy xách hai túi mua sắm nặng.

definition: to put on clothes to see if they fit
exampleSentence: Can I try on these clothes?
exampleTranslation: Tôi mặc thử mấy món đồ này được không?

definition: to pay the normal price, without a discount
exampleSentence: I don't want to pay full price for it.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không muốn trả đủ giá cho nó.

definition: costing 50 percent less than the normal price
exampleSentence: All the shoes are half price today.
exampleTranslation: Hôm nay tất cả giày đều nửa giá.

definition: a lower price for a short time
exampleSentence: There is a special offer on coffee this week.
exampleTranslation: Tuần này có ưu đãi đặc biệt cho cà phê.

definition: available to buy, often at a lower price
exampleSentence: These jackets are on sale this week.
exampleTranslation: Tuần này những chiếc áo khoác này đang giảm giá.

definition: to ask to pay less than the normal price
exampleSentence: You can ask for a discount if you buy two.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể xin giảm giá nếu mua hai cái.

definition: to request your money back
exampleSentence: She asked for a refund because the shirt was too small.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy yêu cầu hoàn tiền vì chiếc áo quá nhỏ.

definition: to take something back to the shop
exampleSentence: You can return an item within 30 days.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể trả lại hàng trong vòng 30 ngày.

definition: to not throw away the paper that shows what you paid
exampleSentence: Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
exampleTranslation: Hãy giữ hóa đơn phòng khi cần trả hàng.

definition: a plastic card you use to buy things and pay later
exampleSentence: Do you accept credit cards?
exampleTranslation: Bên bạn có nhận thẻ tín dụng không?

definition: to take money out of your bank account
exampleSentence: I need to withdraw some cash.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần rút ít tiền mặt.

definition: to look at the prices of similar things to find the cheapest
exampleSentence: I compare prices online before I buy anything.
exampleTranslation: Tôi so sánh giá trên mạng trước khi mua bất cứ thứ gì.

definition: to be very expensive
translation: đắt kinh khủng, tốn cả gia tài
exampleSentence: That car must have cost a fortune.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc xe đó chắc đắt kinh khủng.

definition: to stand in a row of people waiting for something
exampleSentence: We waited in line for an hour.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xếp hàng chờ cả tiếng.

definition: to buy something
exampleSentence: You must make a purchase to get the gift.
exampleTranslation: Bạn phải mua hàng thì mới được nhận quà.

definition: to ask a company to supply goods
exampleSentence: I placed an order online yesterday.
exampleTranslation: Hôm qua tôi đã đặt hàng trên mạng.

definition: delivery that you do not have to pay for
exampleSentence: We offer free delivery on orders over fifty dollars.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi giao hàng miễn phí cho đơn trên năm mươi đô.

definition: buying things on the internet
exampleSentence: Online shopping is very convenient.
exampleTranslation: Mua sắm trực tuyến rất tiện.

definition: worth the price you pay
exampleSentence: The hotel is good value for money.
exampleTranslation: Khách sạn này rất đáng đồng tiền.

definition: to pay more than the basic price
exampleSentence: You have to pay extra for delivery.
exampleTranslation: Bạn phải trả thêm tiền giao hàng.

definition: no longer available because all of it has been sold
exampleSentence: The tickets are sold out.
exampleTranslation: Vé đã bán hết.

definition: available in a shop
exampleSentence: Do you have this in stock?
exampleTranslation: Bên bạn còn món này không?

definition: not available in a shop at the moment
exampleSentence: That color is out of stock.
exampleTranslation: Màu đó đã hết hàng.

definition: a card with money on it that you give as a present
exampleSentence: I gave her a gift card for her birthday.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tặng cô ấy một thẻ quà tặng nhân dịp sinh nhật.
